note: Rustic Superior National Forest campground under red pines on the shore of Eighteen Lake, east of Isabella at the end of Eighteen Lake Road off Forest Road 369, with a picnic area, a loop trail round the lake and a carry-down boat access. The pull-in sites are not built for RVs; a 23-ft rig may fit, with sloped gravel access reported. Pack out all garbage. --Claude
summary: Superior NF page read: 3 pull-in sites, each >21 ft, 'not specifically designed for RVs'; free; vault toilet, no water; May 8 - Oct 1 (gate closes Oct 26); no rec.gov listing (FCFS). WATERFRONT: lakefront -> lakeview proposed (sites under continuous red-pine canopy ~35-40 m from the shore; no site photos or site map). Pin = FS coordinates, OK. Phone none -> 218-663-8060.
flags: Waterfront: lakefront -> lakeview (downgrade). The FS page says the sites are 'under red pines on the shore of Eighteen Lake', but no site map or campsite photo exists, and both Esri (winter, near-black) and USGS imagery show only continuous pine canopy east of the shore, with the access road/carry-down track reaching the water about 40 m north-west of the pin. The pin (the FS coordinate) is ~35-40 m from the shoreline. Open ground to the water cannot be seen or named for any site, so lakefront is not earned; the agency's 'on the shore' and the ~40 m distance under red pines (open trunks) support at most lakeview. If the reviewer wants a photo-backed view before keeping even lakeview, not waterfront is the fallback.

Rig fit (caveat, not a drop): 'Sites are pull-in and not specifically designed for RVs. However, all three sites are longer than 21 feet and may accommodate an RV.' No length of 23 ft+ is stated; the inclusion evidence's '~34 ft' is not on the current page. Unclear fit = keep with the caveat (already in the note). No recent review naming a 23 ft+ rig was searched.
Booking: no recreation.gov facility found; reservable false / fcfs always written per the README rule (were derived from note prose with the same values).
Season: 'Seasons of Use May 8 - October 1'; current conditions 'Closed–no fees or services. Gate closes on October 26.' (ordinary end of season, no status).
Phone: none stored -> 218-663-8060 (Tofte Ranger District, on the campground page).

Forest alerts: 'Post Wildfire Closures, Effective October 1, 2026' is listed among Superior NF alerts; the campground page itself shows only the seasonal closure, so this campground does not appear to be under a closure order (the alert text was not opened).
Note: rewritten to drop the repeated facility/fee/booking facts; the 'sloped gravel access' remark is kept as reported (no current page states or contradicts it).
